chapter: Brass band style, leadership and recording
title: Being a leader and running the business
summary: He says he is a leader who wants the whole business to go straight.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Do you see yourself as a, I should say, a natural leader? It seems that, why is it that, my question is why trumpet players become leaders?
I don't know why other guys become leaders or whatever. So my theory in life is to be a leader. I'm not a follower. I'm a leader. You follow me.
That's my theory in life and anything I do. Whether it's playing trumpet or anything else. I say what's going on. I like to, I guess the guy, my other friend, yeah, he likes to be the boss. I do.
I like to see that it's going straight.
So that's, so by you being the leader, you know that the business is being done.
It's going right. And if it's not going right, that's my fault too.
